description:
Workspace gap surfaced while implementing bd:JMAP-v9py.8 (slow_mode_check rateLimited error response).

# Context

The workspace has TWO SetError types:

1. `jmap_types::SetError` (`crate-jmap-types/src/methods.rs:160-199`):
   - String-typed error_type field
   - HAS `#[serde(flatten)] pub extra: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>`
   - Used by **clients** to deserialize SetError responses
   - The jmap-chat-client crate's `server_retry_after(&SetError) -> Option<UTCDate>` helper at `crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:1295` reads serverRetryAfter from this extra map

2. `jmap_server::backend::SetError` (`crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs:17-45`):
   - Enum-typed error_type field
   - HAS individual typed fields (properties, existing_id, max_recipients, etc.) via `with_*` builders
   - Does NOT have an `extra` map
   - Used by **handlers** as the return shape of `BackendSetError::SetError(set_err)`

The gap: handler code that wants to emit an extension-defined SetError carrying a custom extra field (e.g. `serverRetryAfter` on `rateLimited` per the JMAP Chat draft, `mdnAlreadySent` extras, future extension shapes) cannot do so through the typed builder because the server-side SetError has no extras slot. The current workaround used by chat-server bd:JMAP-v9py.8 (`handle_message_set` create path) is to bypass the typed SetError entirely and write raw JSON into `not_created.insert(...)`:

    not_created.insert(create_id.clone(), json!({
        "type": "rateLimited",
        "description": "Slow mode is active for this chat",
        "serverRetryAfter": retry_after_str,
    }));

This is fine for the immediate need (the slow_mode_check returns a typed SlowModeError, not a BackendSetError), but the gap will hit again when any other extension hook wants to surface an extension SetError back through the `backend.create_object / update_object / destroy_object` interface.

# Acceptance

- `jmap_server::backend::SetError` gains `pub extra: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>` (default empty, `#[serde(flatten, skip_serializing_if = ...)]` matching the jmap-types extras-policy shape on Email/Message/etc.).
- New builder: `pub fn with_extra(mut self, key: &str, value: serde_json::Value) -> Self`.
- Round-trip preservation test: serialize a SetError with extras, deserialize, check extras survived.
- Field is `#[non_exhaustive]` struct-compatible (additive, non-breaking).
- Downstream consumer (jmap-chat-server) updated to use `with_extra("serverRetryAfter", json!(retry_after_str))` instead of the raw-JSON workaround currently in `message.rs` slow_mode_check rejection.

# Out of scope

- Renaming `SetErrorType::RateLimit` to `RateLimited` (separate workspace inconsistency, separate bead — current variant emits wire string `"rateLimit"` which no current spec uses).
- The `now_plus_secs_utc_string(n: u64)` helper (different concern: clock-arithmetic helper, only needed if any kit code wants to compute future UTCDates without chrono).

# Cross-references

- bd:JMAP-v9py.8 — slow_mode_check bead that surfaced the gap (closed; uses raw-JSON workaround).
- `crate-jmap-types/src/methods.rs:151-158` — the workspace extras-policy doc comment that mentions this gap by name ("JMAP Chat's `serverRetryAfter` for slow-mode rate limiting").
- Workspace AGENTS.md "Extras-preservation policy for vendor/site fields" section.
title: jmap-server: add extra: Map<String, Value> + with_extra(k,v) builder to backend::SetError
